newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slightly firmer on crude, market quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slightly firmer on crude, market quiet.

text.p: NWE naphtha was only slightly firmer on Monday as the market ignored strong gains by crude futures, traders said.
Naphtha swaps firmed slightly with May paper quoted around $180/$181, June at $186/$186.50 and July $1.0 above there.
Traders attributed the swaps' gains to strength in crude futures. June IPE futures were 65 cents higher at $19.58 a barrel at 1723 GMT.
The physical market remained fairly lacklustre with no deals reported. Russian barrels were reported offered at around $173/$174 cif NWE.
Full-range material was assessed $1-$2 above there.
